name: Request Smuggler
description: Detect HTTP/1 desynchronization, including concurrent 0.CL contamination, plus HTTP/2 downgrade, splitting, response-queue, and tunnelling discrepancies with bounded differential controls.

actions.name: scan
actions.description: Run bounded HTTP/1 and exact HTTP/2 marker pipelines with interleaved controls against one saved request.

confirm_intrusive.description: Acknowledge that desynchronization probes may affect a reused upstream connection.

max_techniques.description: Bound the number of framing variants. A full default five-cycle scan can schedule up to 608 requests.

probe_path.description: Optional idempotent origin-form path used by outer and victim requests.

canary_path.description: Optional harmless path whose direct response is used as the contamination oracle.

connection_state_host.description: Host value tested both directly and as the second request on one established HTTP/1 connection.

connection_state_path.description: Origin-form path used for the second-request connection-state comparison.

tunnel_path.description: Harmless inner path used by HTTP/2 tunnelling probes; defaults to probe_path.

tunnel_outer_path.description: Short outer response path used to expose a larger nested HTTP/1 response.

pause_ms.description: Pause after the first request headers for the opt-in pause family.

pause_await_response.description: Continue as soon as one complete early response arrives. Leave false when the technique requires the full fixed pause.

include_auth.description: Explicitly copy Cookie and Authorization from the saved request into intrusive raw probes.
